## About IGOR

IGOR is a forum for members of the DGPs section Biological Psychology and Neuropsychology to exchange approaches for open and reproducible research. Its activities include community projects, training for early-career researchers and the annual IGOR Prize for Open and Reproducible Science. The founding document (in German) is available [here](https://www.dgps.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Fachgruppen/Biologische_Psychologie_und_Neuropsychologie/PDF/IGOR_Gruendungsversion_21012020.pdf).

## BIDS Consultation Hour

Since 2024 I have organised the [IGOR BIDS Consultation Hour](https://igor-biodgps.github.io/igor_bids_consultation/), an online forum in which researchers receive advice on converting their datasets to the [Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS)](https://bids.neuroimaging.io). I cover EEG and motion data; a colleague covers MRI. The website also collects BIDS training materials.

## EEG/ERP preprocessing umbrella review

With Yu-Fang Yang, Mario Reutter-Dieker and Johannes Rodrigues, I co-lead an [umbrella review of EEG/ERP preprocessing practices](https://github.com/ufangYang/igor-preprocessing-umbrella-review). It synthesises how preprocessing pipelines and parameters are reported and justified in the literature, with the aim of shared extraction standards. The review is [preregistered on OSF](https://osf.io/uqenv/).

## Further IGOR projects

- [**ARIADNE**](https://igor-biodgps.github.io/ARIADNE/intro.html): an interactive navigator of resources for each step of a transparent research project ([Hartmann et al., 2025](https://doi.org/10.1177/25152459241297674)). I contributed glossary terms during its revision.
- [**Enhancing precision in human neuroscience**](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.85980): a community review ([Nebe et al., 2023](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.85980)) with an accompanying [workshop](https://github.com/IGOR-bioDGPs/precision_workshop_2024).
